title: In situ Learning-Based Spin Engineering of Pulsed Dynamic Nuclear Polarization
summary: Pulsed Dynamic Nuclear Polarization (DNP) is currently receiving substantial interest as a means to enhance the sensitivity of nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) by orders of magnitude. It has also received much attention as a central ingredient in many modalities of electron spin-involved quantum sensing.
